name: Pierre Mauroy
assessment: Dated March 24 issue reports Mauroy re-election after the Rennes synthesis, and page 3 independently lists him as first secretary. Printed issue attestation is not the election effective day or an opening January 1 claim.

name: Pierre Mauroy
assessment: Pages 4–6 separate Mauroy January 7 declaration, recalled May 14, 1988 election, Fabius Thursday January 9 election, printed acceptance address and current title. Departure is reported without an effective end; January 10 is issue attestation for undated printed statements.

name: Laurent Fabius
assessment: Pages 4–6 separate Mauroy January 7 declaration, recalled May 14, 1988 election, Fabius Thursday January 9 election, printed acceptance address and current title. Departure is reported without an effective end; January 10 is issue attestation for undated printed statements.

name: Michel Rocard
assessment: Page 6 roster and adjacent article identify Rocard as first secretary. November 12 is issue attestation; the article also discusses November 4, without converting it into an additional holder row.

name: Henri Emmanuelli
assessment: Pages 4 and 7 date June 19 no-confidence/election and describe resignation procedure. Page 8 uses Emmanuelli first-secretary title while discussing confirmation by a future congress; nearby commentary calls it provisional. Accepted only dated title observation, not permanent mandate or start/end.

name: Lionel Jospin
assessment: Pages 9–10 print Jospin roster and results separately. Page 14 lower-left FLNKS communiqué explicitly says Wednesday October 18 and closes October 18; adjacent October 17 labels belong to different items. Corrected locator only, retaining holder October 18.

name: Lionel Jospin
assessment: Page 2 distinguishes delegated responsibility for Hollande from Jospin retaining the full title until the next congress; future ratification is not an effective start. The issue date bounds the printed present-tense observation, not an unprinted Bureau meeting date.

name: François Hollande
assessment: Page 11 prints the vote totals and a separate current secretariat list headed by Hollande. Page 2 repeats a November 25 communiqué; the accepted December 5 observation uses the dated issue/list, without inventing a November 25 effective start.

name: Martine Aubry
assessment: Pages 3, 6 and 9 separately support Aubry title, November 25 election/report and vote totals. Page 52 explicitly dates the Hollande farewell November 19, which is not an effective resignation boundary.

name: Harlem Désir
assessment: Page 3 dates the Jarnac gathering January 8 and names Désir in the first-secretary role; the issue interval beginning January 12 is not substituted for this event day.

name: Jean-Christophe Cambadélis
assessment: Pages 1–2 explicitly date the Cambadélis election April 15, give percentages and report Désir leaving for government; page 3 independently lists the current secretary. The projected next congress is not an end boundary.

name: Olivier Faure
assessment: Statement has July 9, 2018 dateline and Faure signature with party secretary title separate from his parliamentary title. Supports party-office observation only.

name: Olivier Faure
assessment: Main text explicitly dates Faure closing the national council March 11, 2023 and calls him current first secretary; page publication metadata March 13 is not substituted.
